name: Sky Monarch
description: (Tag:air)(Tag:air+)(Tag:air-resistance+)(Tag:electric)(Tag:electric+)(Tag:electric-resistance+)You are the Sky Monarch, ruler of all Sky; your agility is massively enhanced, as you are as free as wind. All your wind and lightning-related abilities below Mythical Tier are increased by one rank and cost less energy. All sky-aligned beings instinctively recognize you as Monarch, and you are immune to wind and lightning-based abilities.
